walkthroughs.body_html:
Inject mouse with antigen → lymphocytes are produced.

Fuse lymphocytes with tumour cells to make hybridomas. They divide forever AND make one specific antibody.

Pregnancy tests, disease diagnosis, targeted cancer treatment, locating clots, separating molecules.

Edexcel asks you to evaluate — high specificity but cost, side effects, ethics.

Carcinogens (e.g. tobacco), UV radiation and viruses can trigger cancer by mutating DNA.

Preventable risks: smoking, obesity, alcohol, sun. Roughly 4 in 10 cancers linked to lifestyle.
